# ffxf_database_logical_database (Resource)

Manages the logical_database feature of an FFXF Cloud database. Database features are in beta; accounts without access receive HTTP 403.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_database_logical_database" "example" {
  database_id = 42
  name        = "analytics"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (Number) Parent database ID.
- `name` (String) Logical database name, up to 63 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform identifier for this managed database object.
